en: The front of the postcard depicts three black-and-white historical views from Liden village: a rural panorama with wooden houses, an old stone church labeled 'Gamla kyrkan byggd på 1300-talet' (Old church built in the 1300s), and a prominent two-story building labeled 'Tingshuset' (the courthouse). The reverse displays handwritten notes in Swedish, postal divisions, and an address. The card features multilingual 'post card' headers and printing information (Max Sellmann, Mariedal).
